items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I had Duke Jordan on piano all the time and Vinnie Dean on alto, a variety of drummers. I had a lot of different drummers. Osie Johnson, Gus Johnson, Eddie Shaughnessy, Joe Morello.

ctx.x: Right. You had your own, some Monday nights at Birdland.

Well for a while I had my own group. In other words, when I was going to school, you know that Manhattan School of Music, I got a group together. I had Duke Jordan on piano all the time and Vinnie Dean on alto, a variety of drummers. I had a lot of different drummers. Osie Johnson, Gus Johnson, Eddie Shaughnessy, Joe Morello. And I worked Birdland and The Bohemia and we worked around Connecticut and around Jersey. So in fact I did an album called “Kaleidoscope” which hasn’t been put out on CD, and that was that…
Was there ever any issues about integrated bands at the time?
